svg.text: Candidate-ranking models: accuracy, speed and footprint
ms, median, 4 threads, lower is better
ms, median, DirectML, lower is better
MB of private memory added, lower is better
MB of dedicated GPU memory, lower is better
first-candidate accuracy %, 822 of 4-16 chars, higher is better
(j) Long input · last syllable an initial
ms, a whole query in full pinyin, CPU 4 threads, lower is better
ms, a whole query in full pinyin, CPU 4 threads, lower is better
Metaseq = metasequoiaime/pinyin-ime-reranker (Chinese only), shown with the engine rank prior; alone 42.0 / 48.2% in (a),
71.1 / 79.4% in (b). Laya (orig.) = the untuned convaiinnovations/laya multilingual model, same prompt. Zhiyi 1.1 = fine-tuned
mmBERT-base; Zhiyi 1.2 = mmBERT-small distilled from it; Zhiyi 1.4V2 = 1.4's unified model (1.2 plus a head that composes long
pinyin) retrained on 1.5.4's long-form web text; Zhiyi 1.5.4 = the head replaced by a decoder that writes the sentence a character
at a time. (a), (i) and (j) for 1.4V2 and 1.5.4 are end to end in the IME engine (after the pause); in (i) (j) Frequency is the
engine composing alone and Zhiyi 1.2 picks among its sentences. (d)-(h) are a page of word choice; 1.5.4's decoder only runs for
long input after the pause, and (f) (h) include it. Accuracy: int8 on the CPU, right words not shown count as wrong. Speed and
footprint: ONNX Runtime 1.24.4, int8, the same 400 pages (context up to 128 characters), Ryzen 5 9600X / RTX 5070 Ti. In the IME,
Zhiyi's weights are mapped from a local cache, so its private memory is lower than (f). (k) (l): a whole query for the 822 phrases
in full pinyin in the IME engine (word choice and lattice included, the last key computed at once; in the IME, composition runs in
the background after a pause). 1.5.6's KV cache lets the decoder compute only the new character each time; first candidates unchanged.
